headline: How did the Milwaukee Brewers take a commanding World Series lead?
standfirst: The Milwaukee Brewers rallied from an early four-run deficit to defeat the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4, securing a 2-0 lead in the 2026 World Series.
keyPoints: The Milwaukee Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4 in Game 2 of the 2026 World Series.
Milwaukee erased an early 4-0 first-inning deficit to take a 2-0 series lead.
Sal Frelick hit a crucial tying home run in the sixth inning.
Rookie Cooper Pratt drove in the go-ahead run in the seventh inning.

sections.heading: What happened in Game 2 of the World Series?
paragraphs: The Milwaukee Brewers put on a thrilling display of resilience at American Family Field, overcoming a heavy early deficit to beat the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4. With the victory, the Brewers claimed a 2-0 lead in the best-of-seven Fall Classic as the matchup shifts venues.

Both franchises are seeking their first-ever World Series title, creating an electric atmosphere for the historic games in Milwaukee. Game 2 delivered immediate drama when the Rays stormed out of the gates in the opening frame.

sections.heading: How did the Tampa Bay Rays build their early lead?
paragraphs: Facing rookie starting pitcher Logan Henderson, the Tampa Bay Rays' offense came alive right away in the top of the first inning. Key hits, including a two-run home run by Liam Hicks, helped stake the visitors to a quick 4-0 advantage.

However, the Brewers quickly began chipping away at the lead against Tampa Bay starter Drew Rasmussen. Milwaukee steadily manufactured runs through aggressive baserunning and timely hitting to stay within striking distance.

sections.heading: Who delivered the crucial hits for Milwaukee?
paragraphs: The comeback gained serious momentum in the sixth inning when outfielder Sal Frelick launched a solo home run deep over the center-field fence to tie the game at 4-4. It was Frelick's first home run in months, sending the home crowd into a frenzy.

In the seventh inning, young infielder Cooper Pratt followed up by looping a sinker into short right field for a go-ahead single. The Brewers' bullpen then locked down the victory, shutting out the Rays the rest of the way to seal the 5-4 win.

sections.heading: What lies ahead in the series?
paragraphs: History heavily favors teams that manage to secure a 2-0 lead in the World Series, though the job is far from finished. The series now shifts down to Florida for Game 3 at Tropicana Field.
The Tampa Bay Rays will need to regroup quickly on their home turf to avoid falling into an insurmountable 3-0 deficit against a surging Milwaukee team.

highlight: The Milwaukee Brewers stunned the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4 for a 2-0 World Series lead by overcoming a four-run deficit for the second time in the postseason.
